# A tree the scanner plants under a temporary root: a line `== <path>` starts
# the file at <path>. main.sh does not set pipefail and sources a library through
# $HERE; the library sources a second one through $REPO_ROOT. Neither library
# sets pipefail, so the readers they hold are not flagged.
== hack/x/main.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)"
# shellcheck source=lib/reader.sh
. "$HERE/lib/reader.sh"
first_line
== hack/x/lib/reader.sh
# A library: it sets no shell options of its own.
. "$REPO_ROOT/hack/x/lib/inner.sh"
first_line() { gen | head -1; }
== hack/x/lib/inner.sh
first_match() { gen | grep -m1 pat; }
